SELECT c.id AS conversationId, c.type AS conversationType,
-- 会话显示名/头像：群用 conversations；单聊用对方用户信息 CASE WHEN c.type = 'GROUP' THEN c.name ELSE u.username END AS conversationName,
CASE WHEN c.type = 'GROUP' THEN c.avatar ELSE u.avatar_url END AS conversationAvatar,
c.owner_id AS ownerId,
c.last_msg_id AS lastMsgId, c.last_seq AS lastSeq,
uc.pinned AS pinned, uc.mute AS mute, uc.last_read_seq AS lastReadSeq, uc.unread_count AS unreadCount, uc.list_cursor_seq AS listCursorSeq, uc.updated_at AS listUpdatedAt
FROM user_conversation uc JOIN conversation c ON c.id = uc.conversation_id
-- 找到单聊“对方那条成员记录”（群聊会 join 出多条，所以要限制在 type=1 才 join） LEFT JOIN conversation_members cm_peer ON cm_peer.conversation_id = c.id AND cm_peer.user_id <> #{userId} AND c.type = 1
LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = cm_peer.user_id
WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId}
ORDER BY uc.pinned DESC, uc.list_cursor_seq desc LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT id, type, peer_key AS peerKey, name, avatar, owner_id AS ownerId, last_msg_id AS lastMsgId, last_seq AS lastSeq, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM conversation WHERE id = #{conversationId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, type, peer_key AS peerKey, name, avatar, owner_id AS ownerId, last_msg_id AS lastMsgId, last_seq AS lastSeq, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM conversation WHERE peer_key = #{peerKey} AND type = 'USER' LIMIT 1
SELECT last_seq FROM conversation WHERE id = #{conversationId} LIMIT 1
